# Security and Responsible Disclosure Policy

Submit vulnerabilities through the
[HHS responsible disclosure portal](https://hhs.responsibledisclosure.com).
Do not post vulnerability details in public GitHub issues or pull requests.

Read the repository's [security and responsible disclosure guidance](../documentation/SECURITY.md)
and the [HHS Vulnerability Disclosure Policy](https://www.hhs.gov/vulnerability-disclosure-policy/index.html)
for research scope, reporting instructions and disclosure terms.
